pivot_reason: All preregistered OHLCV attention mechanisms and the breadth switch failed. The next experiment changes both data and model structure rather than refining thresholds.
economic_hypothesis: Depth depletion, VPIN and Hawkes intensity identify when a move large enough to pay costs is likely, while direction must be estimated separately from price, taker flow and book imbalance. Trading is allowed only when both opportunity hazard and direction confidence agree.

data.official_execution_panel: official Binance Vision BTCUSDT USD-M 5-minute klines
data.restriction: The derived state panel is discovery-only. Every survivor must be reconstructed from checksum-verified official Binance archives before Champion or Paper/Live consideration.
data.future_columns: physically absent from the state input

information_contract.oi_and_positioning: delayed one additional completed five-minute bar
information_contract.labels: future path is used only as a training target after the entire horizon has elapsed

labels.hazard: either upward or downward official excursion from next open reaches 40bp within the horizon
labels.direction: the side whose official excursion reaches the larger magnitude; trained only on hazard-positive resolved examples

feature_contract.rolling_normalization: prior-only one-day and seven-day z scores

gates.promotion: prohibited until official raw feature reconstruction and independent asset validation
